conventions.convention: The index set is finite. Parameters satisfy Q1–Q4: nonzero off-diagonal polynomials, Qij(u,v)=Qji(v,u), weighted homogeneity, and nonzero extremal coefficients. R(0)=k.

Equal-color crossings act by (f−sf)/(x_a−x_{a+1}); consequently τ_a x_a−x_{a+1}τ_a=1 and τ_a x_{a+1}−x_aτ_a=−1. The braid difference is τ_{a+1}τ_aτ_{a+1}−τ_aτ_{a+1}τ_a, with numerator Q(x_a,x_{a+1})−Q(x_{a+2},x_{a+1}).

Degrees refer to word components: dots have degree 2d_i and crossings degree −b_ij. Diagrams compose bottom to top, with the right factor below the left. Internal shifts satisfy (M{r})_m=M_{m−r}, and q[P]=[P{1}].
Induction uses the ordered separated-block algebra inside its idempotent corner. Generic coinduction reverses the blocks and shifts by (β|γ); same-ordered unshifted biadjunction is not asserted.
The divided-power column uses the reflected idempotent and shift −d_i binomial(n,2). Projective duality is homogeneous Hom into R, twisted by the generator-fixing anti-involution; it reverses shifts.
The tensor Cartan form is symmetric and A-bilinear. The homogeneous-Hom form is conjugate-linear in its first variable and linear in its second, with h(P{r},Q{s})=q^(s−r)h(P,Q).

The global-basis identification assumes symmetric Cartan matrix, d_i=1, characteristic-zero coefficients, and finite loopless quiver parameters Qij(u,v)=(-1)^hij(u−v)^(hij+hji). Arbitrary parameter changes require a proved gauge equivalence. The inherited geometric and quantum Axiom of Choice assumptions are carried.

load_bearing.statement: Let Q be a KLR datum as in def-quiver-hecke-klr-algebra-for-a-symmetrizable-cartan-datum over any field k. Then γ:Af→K₀(R) is an isomorphism of Z[q,q⁻¹]-algebras and of N[I]-graded twisted bialgebras, intertwining multiplication, comultiplication, bar involutions and forms.

For a KLR datum Q and a fixed reduced-expression system, the monomials τ_w x₁^a₁⋯x_n^a_n e(ν), over w∈S_n, nonnegative exponents and ν∈I^n, form a k-basis of R_n(Q). Each R(β) is bounded below with finite-dimensional homogeneous components, and its graded ranks are independent of Q.

For any graded KLR datum over any field, a simple S with maximal positive i-tail r has maximal restriction N⊠L(i^r), with N simple and ε_i(N)=0. Conversely Ind(N⊠L(i^r)) has a unique simple head, occurring once, with every other composition factor having smaller i-tail. Simples are absolutely simple, and triangularly selected divided-word projective classes form an A-basis. The same assertions hold for maximal first-color blocks.

For a KLR datum and β,γ∈Q₊, induction and restriction are exact, commute with internal shifts and preserve finitely generated graded projectives. Ind is left adjoint to Res; Coindβ,γ(M⊠N)≅Indγ,β(N⊠M){(β|γ)}. The block corners have the stated finite Mackey filtration, with shift minus the pairing of the crossed middle blocks.

For every KLR datum, the divided-power projective classes satisfy Σ_(a+b=1−aij)(−1)^a[P_i,a][P_j,1][P_i,b]=0 for i≠j. The assignment θ_i↦[P_i,1] extends to an A-linear algebra homomorphism γ:Af→K₀(R), taking divided words to ordered induced divided-power projectives and respecting coproducts and bar involutions.

For a KLR datum and homogeneous x,y∈Af_ν, T(γ(x),γ(y))=B_L(x,y)=C_ν B_K(x,y), where C_ν=∏_i(1−q_i²)^−ν_i. The Hom form satisfies h(γ(x),γ(y))=B_L(bar(x),y), and the divided-power self-pairing is ∏_(a=1)^n(1−q_i^(2a))⁻¹.

For any graded KLR datum over any field, simple shift orbits and their projective covers have unique self-dual normalizations. If a normalized simple has maximal first i-block r with remaining normalized simple S_a of first i-tail zero, then [P_i,r][P_a]=[P_b]+Σ_(ε_i^L(S_c)>r)m_c(q)[P_c], with nonnegative bar-invariant Laurent multiplicities. The left divided-string ideal corresponds to the span of covers with first i-tail at least n; conditionally signed global vectors have positive signs.

For symmetric Cartan data with d_i=1, characteristic-zero field and finite loopless quiver-geometric parameters, γ(G(b))=[P_b] identifies the lower global basis with uniquely normalized self-dual indecomposable graded projective shift orbits, compatibly with the based highest-weight quotient. No extension to arbitrary parameters or non-symmetric data is asserted.

concerns.concern: The Statement defines ε_i(M)=max{r:e(β−rα_i,rα_i)M≠0} for every finite-dimensional graded module M. For M=0 the set is empty, so this maximum is undefined. Supply an explicit zero-module convention or restrict this definition to nonzero modules. The subsequent assertions about simples avoid this boundary, but the definition as written does not.

Example (b) calls [Q(x₁,x₂)−Q(x₃,x₂)]/(x₃−x₁) 'the second difference of the quadratic parameter in its first variable.' It is a first divided difference, with the displayed sign. The computed correction x₁+x₃−2x₂ is correct.

alerts.finding: F3 attributes to thm-klr-pbw-basis-theorem: 'monic division by a monic polynomial of degree q produces an Artin basis of the quotient, with no division by factorials and no characteristic restriction.' The cited theorem states the affine KLR monomial basis, Hilbert series and local finiteness over a field; it does not state this monic-quotient result. Steps 1.1–2.1 use F3 for splitting-ring and quotient calculations. The elementary monic-division fact can be stated and justified locally, but its present attribution is stronger than the supplier.

seams_checked.note: Divided powers, rational Serre presentation and half-form nondegeneracy are used with their stated domains. The integral form is treated as the divided-power subalgebra, without an unsupported torsion-free-to-free inference. Inherited AC is retained.

The root-color factor B_L=C_νB_K, integral balanced intersection, signed norm-one residue criterion and exact left-string recursion match the opened supplier statements. The proof does not extrapolate the separate finite-ADE canonical-comparison theorem.

The generic theorem specializes to the supplier's signed quiver parameters. Native polynomial operators, unit degrees −d_ν, source-first Ext corners and opposite-composition multiplication agree. Characteristic-zero and loopless-quiver qualifications are retained.

The global proof uses the actual dimension-shifted pushforwards and their decomposition into shifted simple equivariant perverse objects. It retains arbitrary arrow multiplicities and characteristic zero without adding semismallness or claiming a paving of arbitrary fibers.

Generic presentation, duality, categorification and conditional global-basis uses retain the supplier conventions and geometric scope. One citation is overstated: lem-minimal-parabolic-polynomial-flag-model-realizes-the-graded-diagram-relations F3 attributes monic-quotient Artin-basis facts to the affine PBW theorem. Routed separately in alerts.

The cyclic type-A specialization satisfies Q1–Q4, including the e=2 polynomial −(u−v)². The explicit ψ=−τ dictionary changes the equal-color constants and cubic sign with the stated braid order, while preserving grading.

Opened citation passages preserve internal shifts, type-A component degrees, right-append restriction and the native-to-source crossing sign. Integer-color local dictionaries use finite type-A windows rather than instantiating the finite cyclic definition outside its scope; affine PBW straightening is distinguished from cyclotomic quotient assertions.
